title: We created a survivors like
author: NoStranger3736
selftext:
I want to talk about the process here and what's AI. This project started off mostly code only for AI. We mostly wrote specs, created plans and had agents orchestrate sub agents to build out all the systems. I created code and systems blueprints - AI likes to proliferate a pattern and so setting those foundations up to start means the AI sticks to a way of coding and building. If you have not defined that you will get different patterns emerging everywhere in your code and you will have a lot of technical debt to clean up constantly and your game won't scale as it gets more complex. We solved those problems, now for the art part is mostly self taught he has more of a design eye compared to me who's mostly code. A lot of the art has gone through several iterations of inspiration and concepting with AI before hand drawing in aseprite with our own taste keeping everything in the color palette. Anyways ask any questions you want have a play its mobile only at the moment thank you  
  
**Game Title:** Sweeper Sinclair  
**Playable Link:**  
iOS: [https://apps.apple.com/app/id6748193399](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6748193399)

Android: [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pixellake.ds](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pixellake.ds)

**Platform:** iOS and Android (mobile)  
**Description:** The dungeon is filthy, the monsters are relentless, and all you have is a mop. Sweeper Sinclair is an action roguelike where you play a janitor fighting through endless waves of skeletons, creatures and supernatural horrors using weaponised cleaning supplies. Swing your mop through hordes, lob bleach bottles that leave corrosive puddles, launch toilet brushes like javelins, and spray toxic fumes into anything that moves. Every run starts simple and gets chaotic fast: collect experience from fallen enemies, level up mid-run, and build a loadout from 24 cleaning-themed weapons and abilities. Surviving the timer is just the start. Push into deeper dungeons where enemies grow stronger and more numerous, and see how far you can get before the trash takes you out. Between runs, collect lunchbox items that permanently boost your stats, so every attempt feeds the next one. Sessions are short and built for mobile, with a bestiary, daily and weekly challenges, and tiered achievements if you want something to chase. Cleanliness is next to deadliness.

comments.author: Segaiai
comments.body: Nice result, but way way way too literally and exactly like Vampire Survivors. It's not just a "Survivors-like". But still impressive that you could copy it so exactly.
